summary: Job Form Page UX Refactor - All features tested and working. Progress tracker with 5 steps, collapsible sections, scroll-spy active highlighting, Review section with summary, mobile sticky bottom bar, form submission, and edit mode all functioning correctly.
passed_tests: Progress tracker renders at top with 5 steps (Basic Info, Schedule, Compensation, Requirements, Review)
Clicking a progress step scrolls to that section (smooth scroll working)
Sections are collapsible - clicking section header toggles content visibility
Active section gets highlighted ring when scrolled into view (IntersectionObserver scroll-spy working)
Form fields save correctly - filled out all fields and submitted a new job successfully
Required field validation works (title, specialty, location, description required)
Review section shows summary of entered data with all field values
Review section shows missing fields warning when required fields are empty
Mobile sticky bottom submit bar appears on small viewports (sm:hidden working)
Mobile sticky bar shows '0/4 sections filled' counter
All existing data-testid attributes preserved for form elements
Edit mode: navigating to edit an existing job loads data correctly
Auto-save indicator shows 'Saved' in edit mode
Post Job button works and creates job successfully
Update button works in edit mode
Backend API tests: 8/8 passed (login, specialties, create, get, update, list, validation, delete)
critical_code_review_comments: JobFormPage.jsx implementation is clean and well-structured with proper component separation
IntersectionObserver for scroll-spy is correctly implemented with proper cleanup
Collapsible sections use proper state management with useState
Progress tracker correctly computes completed sections based on form data
Mobile sticky bar properly positioned with z-40 and sm:hidden for responsive behavior
Auto-save in edit mode uses debounced timeout (1500ms) to prevent excessive API calls
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Created test job during testing, cleaned up after tests
